lead_raw_text:
The structure of CuTeSe₂ (Cu₄Te₄Se₈) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 74), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers with a tetrahedral environment of four Se neighbors, Te centers with eight neighbors (four Se and four Te), and two distinct Se environments: one with five neighbors (one Cu, one Se, four Te) and another with six neighbors (three Cu, two Se, one Te). The Cu tetrahedra share corners and edges with each other and with 5-vertex Se polyhedra, while Se–Se pairs share corners and edges. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
